records.title: What NinerLog records
records.logbook: Your logbook: flights, aircraft, licences and everything else you enter.
records.standard: In standard mode, edits overwrite and deletions delete; no history is kept.
records.strict: If you switch strict mode on, or add a licence from a country that requires it: every later change to a flight with its old value, date and reason, and deleted flights as void records. This stays with your logbook until you delete your account.
records.never: Never recorded with history: IP address, device, browser, location.

notice.title: Strict logbook mode is on
notice.byLicence: Your licence {{licence}} requires a logbook that keeps every change, so NinerLog now records one.
notice.manual: From now on NinerLog keeps every change to your flights.

offer.title: Keep a change history?
offer.body: The rules for your licence {{licence}} suggest a logbook that keeps every change. You can switch strict mode on now, or later in Settings.

correction.title: Reason for the correction
correction.body: This entry can no longer be changed freely: its free-edit window, which counts from the flight, has closed, it has been signed, or it lies in a period you certified. The change is kept as a correction together with its reason.
correction.label: Reason
correction.placeholder: e.g. On-block time corrected from the tech log
correction.required: Enter a reason for the correction.

delete.reasonHelp: The flight is kept as a void record with this reason.
delete.strictDescription: The flight leaves your logbook and is kept as a void record, with the reason you give.
delete.unknownDescription: Delete this flight? If strict logbook mode is on, it is kept as a void record.
delete.unknownReasonHelp: If strict logbook mode is on, the reason is kept with the void record.
delete.signedHint: Signed flights can't be deleted. Void the signature first.

voided.title: Voided entries
voided.description: Flights deleted in strict mode, kept as void records.
voided.emptyDescription: Flights you delete in strict mode appear here.
voided.error: Could not load the voided entries.
voided.viewHistoryAria: History of the flight on {{date}} in {{reg}}

historyPage.title: Flight history
historyPage.notFound: No history recorded for this flight.

settings.title: Logbook
settings.strictHelp: Keeps every change to a flight with its old value, date and reason, and keeps deleted flights as void records.
settings.scope: Strict mode and its free-edit window apply to every flight in your logbook, whichever licence it was flown under.
settings.reenableOnSave: Saving one of these licences again switches strict mode back on.

draftWindow.flight_day: Free-edit window: until the end of the flight day. Later changes, and flights entered later, are corrections.
draftWindow.hours_48: Free-edit window: 48 hours from the flight's on-block time. Later changes, and flights entered later, are corrections.

settings.overridesDownwardOnly: Manual overrides may only reduce an auto-calculated time.
settings.turnOffWarning: {{licences}} requires a logbook that keeps every change. Turning strict mode off stops recording; the history already recorded stays with your logbook.
settings.updateFailed: Could not change the logbook mode.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the logbook mode.
settings.noEvents: Strict mode has never been switched on.

certify.title: Certify logbook
certify.help: Confirm that the logbook is complete and correct through a date. Later edits to flights on or before that date are kept as corrections. Nothing is locked.
certify.strictRequired: Switch strict mode on to certify the logbook.
certify.inFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
certify.beforeLatest: The date cannot be before your latest certification ({{date}}).

errors.reasonRequired: This change needs a reason: the flight is past its free-edit window, signed or in a certified period.
errors.overrideExceeds: A manual override may only reduce an auto-calculated value.
errors.reasonTooLong: The reason is too long. Use at most 500 characters.
errors.locked: This flight is locked by a completed signature. Void the signature to change it.
errors.deleteFailed: Could not delete the flight. Please try again.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the change. Please try again.
